feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 15 May 2026 3:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 15 May 2026 at 3:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Today will be mostly dry and bright with sunny intervals, and a moderate to fresh north-westerly wind. Temperatures only reaching up to 12°C at best.

This evening & tonight will be dry with clear spells, as the moderate to fresh northwest wind falls light, with minimum temperature around 6°C.


##Outlook##

Tomorrow will start dry, however outbreaks of rain and drizzle will arrive towards lunchtime, turning more persistent during the evening before clearing overnight. A mainly moderate south to southwest wind which will become a moderate to fresh westerly as the rain clears, with highs of 12°C.

A dry start on Sunday with the chance of some early brightness before it turns cloudy with showery outbreaks of rain developing into the afternoon. A mainly moderate south-westerly wind with maximum temperature of 13°C.
